question: What foundational unity and inner strength are attributed to the lord in this epithet?
premises: The lord is the sole rhythm of the vast ground of all selves.
Knowers of that reality perceive him at that ground.
inference: The lord is praised as the unifying ground of all selves, inwardly strong and recognized by knowers.
uncertainties: The compound segmentation is interpretive due to dense sandhi and compounding.
plain_english: O sole rhythm of the vast ground of all selves, whose true inner strength is perceived at that ground by those who know it!
